hypothesis: On the spent 48-case RX2-O panel with supplied structure and ONE supplied true inverse wiring (true-U or true-V, 96 conditions), a fixed annealer using R95's fixed order-5 objective recovers >=95/97 letters in >=44/48 cases per condition and >=5/6 per turnover cell. No K4 hypothesis is tested.
not_excluded: Every cipher family and every K4 hypothesis; both-wirings-unknown recovery; unknown structure; fresh texts; masking or misspelling; false-positive rates. A failure rejects only these two fixed versions under this objective on this spent panel.
resource_semantics: audit/run_bounded_agg.py per job: wall, aggregate CPU and sampled aggregate RSS (also the per-process RLIMIT_AS). One worker. Zero retries. The sum of job budgets is inside the charter's 1,800/1,800/2,048 development ceiling.
notes: Type C development (charter section 5). Approved by Tyler 23 Nov 2026: 'I approve'. mode=crib_assisted denotes supplied synthetic truth (one true wiring), not K4 letters.
